dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: That rabble we fought sure picked the wrong crew to mess with. I'd say they won't make that mistake again... but we already made sure of that.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: With my skills and experience on your team, they don't stand a chance, no matter what they throw at us.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: I don't have eyes on the back of my head, though, so just make sure you've got my back.
